x: The Belgrave Team,running as Cadogan AC,finished 3rd in the Middlesex '20',held in conjunction with the Finchley Open '20'. John Hilton, Geoff Pearson and Ken Stimpson comprised the team . John's time completed his qualification for our 2nd class standard.
Mel Thorpe had a great race finishing 5th,and the ever-present Charlie Walker completed our scoring team in 22nd place. John Moore,Ken Stimpson and John Baker also enjoyed an outing.
Ken Stimpson shook the Hon.Handicapper by taking first prize with nearly a minute to spare (you are a marked man now Ken!) and J.V.Baker made full use of a 10 minute mark to gain second award.

With Trevor Hart also beating Barratt, the hopes of our two runners were high for the Middlesex Champs. just two weeks hence. Ken Stimpson closed in our scoring 10 in 29th place but we still had to give best to Ealing who packed 9 in 21 for a deserved win.
